page.overview:
Who is Jar Jar Binks's father?

The father of the Otolla Gungan Jar Jar Binks was a Gungan male. Both of Binks' parents had died by 32 BBY. When Binks's clumsiness caused an accident, Boss Rugor Nass lessened his punishment out of respect for Binks's parents. The memory of his father saddened him.

George R. Binks was born in Otoh Gunga on the planet Naboo to a family of whalers. The Binks family had practiced the whaler profession for centuries, so as a mere youth, commanded his own fishing gang in his hometown. At some point, he decided to join the family business, becoming a captain in the Binks & Son Whaling Company. In his capacity as a professional whaler, Binks often went on long sea voyages, even sailing across the entire planet of Naboo on more than one occasion.

At one point, he fell in love with the warrior-woman Sheebla and planned on marrying her, but when he learned of Sheebla's infertility, Binks broke off his wedding plans and left her; to him, a child was more important than love. He eventually married another woman, not out of love, but because she had the ability to bear him an heir.

The Gungan male's female partner had a son, Jar Jar Binks,
